headline: HOMEBODY: say the kind thing — the bond is steerable now
lede: Court commands landed: C compliments whoever is within arm's reach, a FAMILY-tier word deepens into affection with its own chord and hearts, and X hurls an insult that starts a cold war on command — with the human exit still the only way back. An 8-second shared cooldown keeps the meter honest; the whole law rides the state hash, so every seed stays exact.
